component.name: Glance
component.summary: Look at pictures, and make small changes to them

description.p: Glance opens an image and gets out of the way. Arrow keys walk through the folder, the scroll wheel zooms, two fingers on a touchpad pan, and the picture is on screen before you have finished letting go of the mouse. Play the folder as a slideshow, see what the camera recorded about a photo — lens, shutter speed, aperture, ISO, where it was taken — and step through an animated GIF one frame at a time. Live Text finds the text in a picture, even a blurry one, so it can be selected and copied, reading it on your own computer.
When you do need to change something, the editor is one button away and everything in it happens on the picture in front of you rather than in a preview box:

ul.li: Crop by dragging, with the usual aspect presets for social sizes
Resize by handles or by typing the numbers, in pixels, percent, inches or centimetres, with the proportions locked if you want them locked, and set the print resolution
Rotate by a quarter turn, or to any angle you type
Exposure, brightness, contrast, highlights and shadows, saturation, white balance, sepia and sharpness
Levels with a histogram, and Auto Levels
Draw and annotate: pen, highlighter, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse — and pick any drawing up again to move, resize, recolour or delete it
Add text with a font, a size, a colour and a background, dragged where you want it
Convert between formats, and compress or inflate a file to a size you name — so you never have to hand a photograph to a website that sells what you upload

description.p: It opens PDFs too: every page in one scrolling column, fitted to the window and sharp at any zoom, with a sidebar of page thumbnails, the table of contents and your bookmarks, a box to jump to any page, search, and text you can select, copy, highlight in any colour, underline or strike through. Draw on pages with pens and shapes, write text boxes in any font, add notes and speech bubbles, read one page or two at a time, switch to night mode, and see everything the document says about itself. Open password-protected PDFs, protect your own with a password, and make large ones smaller. Redact pictures and PDFs so what is under the black box is gone for good, not just covered, and print either. Combine pages from PDFs and pictures into one PDF: pick the pages, put them in order by dragging, turn them, and save. Changes are saved into the file, with undo.

It reads the formats a photographer actually has: PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, GIF, BMP, ICO, QOI, PNM and TGA; HEIC, HEIF and AVIF; SVG; and camera raw from Canon, Nikon, Sony, Fujifilm, Olympus, Panasonic, Pentax, Leica and the rest. Embedded ICC profiles are honoured, so an Adobe RGB photograph looks the way it should rather than washed out.

screenshot.caption: A picture open, with the rest of the folder along the bottom
Brightness, contrast and saturation, applied to the picture as you move them
Exporting: pick a format, a quality, or a file size to aim for

ul.li: Viewing with zoom, pan, a filmstrip of the folder, and GPU rendering
Editing: crop, resize, rotate to any angle, flip, brightness, contrast, saturation, drawing and text
Export with a choice of format and quality, or aimed at a file size
Colour management, so tagged photographs are shown correctly
